name: Roland Freisler
role: Nazi justice official and president of the People’s Court (1942–1945)
summary: Freisler subordinated criminal justice to Nazi leadership and used political trials and capital punishment against resistance. His legal arguments promoted racial discrimination and bans on interracial relationships.

sources.title: Freisler letters of 15–16 October 1942, introduced as NG-176 in the Justice Trial
